headline: Iron ore prices rebound modestly on near-term support
summary: Iron ore futures and spot prices rebounded modestly, with the most-traded contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange rising 0.86% to 646 yuan per metric ton. Seaborne 61% and 65% indices also climbed.
why: Iron ore is a primary input for steel production; its price is a key indicator of industrial activity, particularly in China.
why_moved: Technical support levels provided a floor for prices, encouraging buying.
